message.fidworkblock.need_patchouli: §cPatchouli is not installed! The Firework Tutorial Scroll requires it. Please install Patchouli and rejoin the world.

advancement.fidworkblock.welcome.title: Fidwork Cooking
advancement.fidworkblock.welcome.descrip: Enter the world, receive the tutorial scroll and begin your cooking journey
patchouli.fidworkblock.startbook.landing: Welcome to this tutorial book.$(br)It introduces the gameplay and content of this mod. Pick a chapter below to get started.
jei.fidworkblock.choppingboard.note.wrap: Put a wrapper on the board, add any item as filling, then right-click to wrap it into a raw food
jei.fidworkblock.choppingboard.note.moon: Place a raw pie on the board and right-click it with a mooncake mold to press a raw mooncake (filling tag kept)
jei.fidworkblock.choppingboard.note.zong: Put filling on a reed leaf, then add glutinous rice to make a raw zongzi
jei.fidworkblock.choppingboard.note.roll: Place dough/dough pieces/wrappers on the board and right-click with a rolling pin to roll it into the next stage (can be repeated)
